objects.description: The organization itself, of which there is exactly one per mounted instance.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the organization calls itself.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What this organization is for, in its own words.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Whether anything runs for this organization at all.

fields.name: default_failure_pipeline_budget
fields.description: How many times a failing pipeline is retried before it stops.

fields.name: inactivity_timeout_seconds
fields.description: How long a run may sit idle before it is abandoned.

fields.name: event_flows
fields.description: The raw event-flow definition, kept verbatim; a workflow with none of its own falls back to this.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the organization was first written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When anything about it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

objects.description: One editable copy of the whole organization, and the only thing anybody edits.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What this round of editing is for.

fields.name: forked_from_id
fields.description: Another draft's id, or a publication's tag, depending on what this was forked from. Empty for a draft started from nothing.

fields.name: forked_from_type
fields.description: Whether this was forked from a draft or from a publication. Empty means it started from nothing.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether this draft is still being edited or has been put away.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the draft was forked.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When anything in it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the draft has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: status
indexes.description: The drafts listing, which reads the open ones first.

objects.description: Something the organization is trying to achieve, broken down by its objectives.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable handle such as G-1, minted once and never edited. A draft's copy keeps the code its original had, which is what survives publishing.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The goal in one line.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What achieving it would mean.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: Where it sits in the listed order.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the goal was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Finds a goal by the handle a person quotes.

indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

fields.name: goal_id

objects.description: A named sequence of work the organization performs, made of work items.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable handle such as W-1, minted once and never edited. The event-flow steps join to it by this code rather than by row id.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What this piece of work is called.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the sequence accomplishes.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: Where it sits in the listed order.

fields.name: event_flows
fields.description: This workflow's own raw event-flow definition; empty falls back to the organization's.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the workflow was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

objects.description: One step of a workflow, carrying the instruction whoever performs it works from.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable handle such as WI-1, minted once and never edited.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow that owns this step.

fields.name: objective_id
fields.description: The objective this step serves. Required — there is no untagged work.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The step in one line.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What doing it involves.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: Where it sits within its workflow.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The instruction handed to whoever or whatever performs this step.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the step was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Finds a step by the handle a person quotes.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

indexes.name: workflow
indexes.description: Reads the steps of one workflow, and backs its delete cascade.

indexes.name: objective
indexes.description: Reads the work serving one objective.

objects.description: One step of a workflow's event flow: what fires it, what runs it, and what it emits.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: code
fields.description: The workflow's code and the step number joined, such as planning:1.1.1.2.1.

fields.name: workflow_code
fields.description: The owning workflow, joined by its stable code rather than by row id.

fields.name: step
fields.description: The dotted step number from the flow this was read out of.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What this step is called.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the step does.

fields.name: step_type
fields.description: Whether this starts a flow, calls a function or runs a handler.

fields.name: trigger_topic
fields.description: The topic that fires this step. Empty for one that starts a flow.

fields.name: trigger_publisher
fields.description: What publishes the firing topic.

fields.name: consumer
fields.description: The service that runs this step's handler.

fields.name: handler_code
fields.description: Which handler executes the step.

fields.name: emits_topics
fields.description: The topics a successful step publishes, comma joined.

fields.name: on_error_emits_topics
fields.description: The topics a failing step publishes, comma joined.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: Where it sits in its flow's order.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the step was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Finds one step by its own composite code.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

indexes.name: workflow_code
indexes.description: Reads one workflow's steps, which is how a flow is assembled.

indexes.name: handler_code
indexes.description: Answers which steps a given handler runs.

fields.name: code

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the seat is called.

fields.name: description

fields.name: id

fields.name: draft_id

fields.name: role_id
fields.description: The seat being assigned. Must be in the same draft as this link.

fields.description: The objective it is assigned to. Must be in the same draft as this link.

fields.name: label
fields.description: How the seat relates to the objective. At most one accountable per objective.

fields.description: When the link was made.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

objects.description: One capability the organization may switch on, from a fixed catalog.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: The catalog's own name for the capability, such as taskmanager or comm.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the capability is called in a listing.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What switching it on gives the organization.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Whether this capability is switched on. Derived from the objectives that link to it, never set directly.

fields.name: locked
fields.description: Whether this capability may never be switched off. The operator door is the only one.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the catalog row was seeded.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.description: Finds a capability by the name the catalog uses.

objects.description: One reason an objective needs a capability, which is what switches that capability on.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: objective_id
fields.description: The objective doing the needing. Must be in the same draft as this link.

fields.name: module_id
fields.description: The capability it needs. Must be in the same draft as this link.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: Why this objective needs it, which is what a reviewer reads.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the link was made.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted

indexes.description: Reads what one objective needs.

indexes.description: Reads what needs one capability, which is what decides whether it is on.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this was published from.

fields.name: content_hash
fields.description: What was published, hashed, so republishing something unchanged can be refused.
